driverInstallation.windows: Download HP OfficeJet Pro 9025e driver from hp.com/support or use HP Smart app from Microsoft Store (recommended). HP Smart provides full functionality including scan, mobile printing, and smart tasks. Driver includes PCL3 for standard printing.
driverInstallation.mac: Install HP Smart app from Mac App Store (recommended) or download driver from hp.com/support. Supports AirPrint for driverless printing. Add printer via System Preferences > Printers & Scanners for full features including scan and fax.
driverInstallation.linux: Install HPLIP from hplip.sourceforge.net. Run hp-setup for automatic configuration. Use CUPS interface for driver installation. Most features supported including duplex, color, and borderless.

commonErrors.description: Print head failure or alignment issue
causes: Print head at end of life
solutions: Run print head cleaning: Touchscreen > Setup > Tools > Clean Printhead
Run cleaning 2-3 times if needed (uses ink)
Let printer rest 30 minutes between deep cleans
Print alignment page: Setup > Tools > Align Printer
Follow instructions to scan or photograph alignment page
Check all ink cartridges have adequate ink
If cleaning doesn't help, print head may need replacement
Contact HP support for print head replacement (not user serviceable)
Check ink levels on touchscreen or in HP Smart app
Replace depleted cartridge with HP 962 or 962XL

Order replacement cartridges before completely empty

generalMaintenance.frequency: When empty or based on Instant Ink delivery
procedure: Wait for printer to be idle
Open cartridge access door
Wait for carriage to stop in center

Pull cartridge out
Remove new HP 962 or 962XL from package

Insert new cartridge at angle, push until it clicks
Close cartridge door
Printer recognizes new cartridge automatically
With Instant Ink: Return empty cartridge in prepaid envelope
